dedupe_keys.name: disaggregation of energy system optimization models using machine learning for identification of active constraints case study dataset

description: David Cardona-Vasquez deposited this case-study dataset at Graz University of Technology. It contains inputs for a year-long economic-dispatch problem representing a stylised Austrian electricity system, including network-flow constraints and imports and exports with neighbouring countries. The metadata identifies separate Austria 2022 and Austria 2023 folders and a three-bus example. A metadata.xlsx workbook explains the folder and file structure. The repository lists a public data.zip archive, with no access charge stated. A reuse licence is unknown in the retrieved metadata and must be established before reuse. The inputs support reproducing the associated work on disaggregating energy-system optimisation models and identifying active constraints with machine learning. They describe study cases, not a verified operational model of the Austrian grid. The temporal sampling interval and individual data-file formats are not stated. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
